To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reaction of trans-α-cyanocinnamides and trans-tertiary butyl 4-mercaptopropenoate in the presences of readily available amine-thiourea catalysts provides a highly efficient and stereoselective access to highly functionalized tetrasubstituted tetrameric tetrahydrothio-phenes bearing three contiguous stereogenic centers, including one quaternary center.

the double Michael reaction of trans-tert- butyl 4- mercapto-2-butanoate and trans-α-cyanocinnamaldehydes, in the presence of an amine thioureas, affords highly functionalized tetrasubstituted tetrahdrothiophenes in good yields, high diastereoselection, and excellent enantiomeric excesses.

the stereoselective formation of highly functionalized 4,4-disubstituted tetralydrothiophenes can be achieved by a double Michael reaction involving an efficient process of dynamic resolution of racemization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of highly functionalised tetrahydrothieno[2,3-d]pyrimidines bearing three contiguous stereogenic centres, including a quaternary one.
the development of an efficient and highly stereoselective synthetic strategy for trisubstitued tetrahydrothio-phene derivatives bearing three contiguous stereogenic centers.
the synthesis of highly functionalised chiral tetrahydrothio-phene derivatives via an enantioselective cascade reaction involving a double Michael addition and a dynamic kinetic resolution process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reaction proceeds in a highly stereoselective manner and the products are obtained with excellent enantio- and diastereoselection, and in high yields.

the reaction of trans-α-cyanocrotonaldehyde and trans-tertiary butyl 4-mercaptopent-2-enoate in the absence of a catalyst, in the presence of an amine thioureas, leads to the formation of the corresponding tetrahydrothienyl compounds in good yield and high diastereoselection.

the reaction of the trans-α-cyanocrotonates with the thiourea and the thiol in the presence of an achiral tertiary amine base in toluene as solvent at 80 °C for 48 hours leads to the corresponding tetrahydrothio- phenes in 60–90% isolated yield and 95–98% ee.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a highly stereoselective double Michael reaction has been achieved in a one-pot operation.

a highly functionalized tetrahedron can be obtained in high yield and excellent diastereo- and enantioselectivities via a dynamic kinetic resolution process involving a cascade double Michael addition.
the thiourea catalyst can efficiently control the stereochemical outcome of a cascade reaction involving a highly challenging dynamic kinetic resolution process.
The main takeaway from our work is that

this reaction can be applied to the asymmetric synthesis of a broad range of highly functionalized trisubstitued tetrahydrothiphenes bearing a quaterary stereocenter in a highly diastereo- and enantioselective manner.
the thiourea catalysts are capable of controlling both the diastereoselection and the enantioselection in a double Michael reaction.
the reaction is highly stereoselective and can be performed with very low catalyst loadings.
